Not worth spending here since I find food here not so tasty.

text.text:
Another interesting place in Koregaon Park with a twist for healthy but tasty food. That’s generally a difficult combination but I was pleasantly surprised wit my the choices which doesn’t compromise on taste and variety.

The ambience is pleasant and we chose to sit outside non the middle of the afternoon and yet felt comfortable. Given there is limited seating I would recommend a table reservation beforehand.

Staff is quite friendly and do recommend options in case you are confused.

Overall a good place to visit.

The outside is well decorated but during summer it would be difficult to dine outside.

text.text:
Sushi Mushi is a pan-Asian delight that has quickly become my go-to spot. The restaurant's sleek design and vibrant atmosphere set the stage for an unforgettable dining experience.

The menu is a symphony of flavors from across Asia, expertly crafted into each dish. From sushi rolls that redefine fresh to mouthwatering Pan-Asian specialties, every bite is a journey.

The sushi is an art form—the perfect balance of taste and texture. The creativity extends to the cocktails, where mixologists weave magic with unique flavors.

What sets Sushi Mushi apart is its commitment to authenticity. Fresh, high-quality ingredients shine in every dish, offering a true taste of Asia.

Whether you're a sushi enthusiast or craving diverse Asian flavors, Sushi Mushi is a must-visit. The attentive staff and culinary prowess make it a standout in KP. I can't wait to explore more of their menu—this place is a Pan-Asian paradise!

text.text:
Tried 4 varieties of mousse from "The Moussecoupe" Koregaon Park and here's my review of the same

1. Meetha paan- This was a revelation as far as taste is concerned as it had a heavy dose of paan flavor infused with traditional mousse. A must try for all paan lovers

2. Chunky brownie - This mousse had crushed brownie pieces in chocolate flavored mousse and was very delicious.

3. Classic chocolate mousse - This was plain and simple chocolate mousse with nothing more than good old chocolate.

4. Layered mocha mousse - This was a bitter too bitter for my taste but lovers of dark chocolate will absolutely love it.

text.text:
The Mousse Coupe : Love bloomed in a cup
.
The mousse Coupe and home delivery kitchen runned in Koregaon Park brings you the real and pure taste of various mousses at your doorstep.
They have a wide range and varieties of mousses that you can select from .
We had a pleasure to taste their some of the famous variants like Nutella , Cafeor , Meetha Paan and Layered mocha .
All the mousses were prepared fresh after the order was been placed , so the texture and finess came out to be original and authentic as we get in the richwood cafes and patisseries .
.
The Main highlight were the presentation and its look that just make you crave for more and more over the time . As it is freshly prepared you have yo consume it before three days .
The mousses are pure and stick to basic Ingredients to keep it real and super healthy . All the variants are eggless and preservative free .
They have kept a serious eye on its healthcare and production .
.
If you have a house warming party or get together then these.mousses will highlight your party and make you confident over .
You can directly order it from online apps where the delivery is free in and around Koregaon park and outside you need to collect from a suitable locatio .
.
Order and try ! Worth every penny !
.
Eat healthy ! Stay Happy !!
